le[a] where a in 0..15 but E may be less... la has length E, d in range(twoE) but le[a] length E not 2E! Right: original x row = le[a] + ge[b], concatenated length 2E. In table I did (la[d]+gb[d]) with d in range(twoE) but la,gb length E. Bug. Need to treat concatenation: for d<E use le[a][d], for d>=E use ge[b][d-E].

Fix.
